title: Benchmark Lab M3 — Interactive Local Model Lab
purpose: Provide a local-first model inventory and durable interactive benchmark workflow from Ollama discovery through live frontend progress and reproducible M2 result presentation.

included: Ollama installed, loaded, capability, loadability, manifest, and qualification state normalization
Isolated Benchmark Lab worker process and versioned JSONL event protocol
Durable summary-safe benchmark run storage, start, status, history, events, and cancellation APIs
Unified shell benchmark inventory, launcher, live progress, results, and history
Legacy console diagnostics for model inventory and benchmark runs
Local fixture, integration, recovery, privacy, and live Ollama acceptance tests
excluded: Automatic model downloads or arbitrary registry pulls
Automatic qualification, promotion, or global enforcement changes
Public leaderboard or universal model ranking
Arbitrary filesystem paths, shell commands, or user-authored benchmark code through the API
Modification or deletion of existing approved Benchmark Lab evidence

acceptanceCriteria.description: The backend and unified frontend discover installed Ollama models and distinguish runtime, installation, load, loadability, manifest-registration, and qualification states without free-text model entry.

evidence.note: Covers online/offline inventory, installed versus loaded state, manifest join, and exact digest.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Model details include an exact runtime slug and digest, and qualification-mode preflight rejects missing, stale, or mismatched provenance.

evidence.note: Covers exact digest match, missing model, and qualification-mode digest mismatch rejection.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Operators can explicitly load and unload a selected local model with bounded keep-alive behavior and structured failures; inventory never loads every model automatically.

evidence.note: Load uses a separate 120-second cold-start timeout and caller-bounded keep-alive; unload is explicit.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The companion exposes a validated summary-safe benchmark suite catalog without importing or crawling Benchmark Lab engine internals.
Benchmark execution runs through an isolated worker that owns Benchmark Lab engine imports and emits versioned summary-safe JSONL events; companion code does not import benchmark-lab/engine.

evidence.note: Covers versioned envelopes, import boundary, malformed JSONL, crash reporting, and bounded timeout.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Validated APIs support benchmark start, list, detail, live events, cancellation, duplicate-submit protection, and restart-safe terminal history through a durable summary-safe run store.

evidence.note: Covers duplicate submit, M2 result persistence, SSE/polling replay, cancellation, corrupt records, and restart recovery.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The unified shell can select a registered model and suite, perform preflight, start quick or qualification runs, receive live progress with reconnect fallback, and recover state after refresh.

evidence.note: Completed run rendered in the unified shell and recovered after browser refresh.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Completed results display M2 pass metrics, Wilson uncertainty, trial count, difficulty strata, critical failures, semantic failure codes, runtime metrics, provenance fingerprint, and qualification-gate reasons without automatic promotion.

evidence.note: Displayed 3/4 pass, Wilson 0.300642-0.954413, three strata, zero critical failures, semantic failure code, exact provenance, and two below-threshold gate reasons.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Raw prompts and model responses remain outside default APIs/browser state, routes remain localhost-only, identifiers are allowlisted, concurrency is bounded, and offline, missing-model, timeout, worker-crash, malformed-event, cancellation, and restart paths are truthful and tested.

evidence.note: 33 assertions cover raw-data exclusion, allowlists, duplicate/concurrency behavior, offline and missing models, timeout, crash, malformed events, cancellation, corrupt history, and restart truthfulness.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A real installed Ollama model completes an end-to-end benchmark from frontend selection through durable backend result, with exact slug/digest provenance and browser-visible refresh recovery verified.

evidence.note: Real llama3.2:latest quick run completed with digest sha256:a80c4f17acd55265feec403c7aef86be0c25983ab279d83f3bcd3abbcb5b8b72 and recovered after refresh; result remains unpromoted screening evidence.
